hook_text: Fourteen transactions, four journals, thirteen ledger accounts. One number tells you if you got it all right.
clip_script: Kasi Cycles, end of November. Post the journals. Money in, R21 000, on the left of the Bank page. Money out, R16 700, on the right. Bank: R18 300. Credit sales, R7 500, to Debtors control. Credit purchases, R11 000, to Creditors control. Then the people pages. Mzansi Couriers owes R4 500, Greenway School R3 000: together R7 500, matching Debtors control. Suppliers: R7 000 and R4 000, R11 000, matching Creditors control. Now the trial balance. Left side: equipment, stock, debtors, bank, cost of sales, wages, rent, bank charges. R95 500. Right side: capital, creditors, sales. R95 500. Balanced. And the profit? R800, exactly as the accounting equation said.
visual_style: Journal totals sliding onto ledger pages, small account cards stacking into two columns, and a final split-screen total of R95 500 on both sides.
mood: Satisfying, building to a clean finish.
pacing: Brisk posting beats, a moment on each control check, a slow reveal of the matching totals.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and draw up Kasi Cycles' trial balance yourself.
